# 🎧 ResonanceFX **System-wide audio, exactly how you want to hear it.** A free, open-source, privacy-respecting audio effects suite for **rooted Android** — a hardened real-time DSP engine, a universal Magisk / KernelSU / APatch module, and a modern Material You app. [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/xeloria/ResonanceFX?style=for-the-badge&label=latest&color=7C4DFF)](https://github.com/xeloria/ResonanceFX/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/xeloria/ResonanceFX/total?style=for-the-badge&label=downloads&color=00C853)](https://github.com/xeloria/ResonanceFX/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/xeloria/ResonanceFX?style=for-the-badge&color=FFB300)](LICENSE) [![Android 5.0+](https://img.shields.io/badge/android-5.0%2B-3DDC84?style=for-the-badge&logo=android&logoColor=white)](#-compatibility) [![Root](https://img.shields.io/badge/root-Magisk%20%7C%20KernelSU%20%7C%20APatch-FF6D00?style=for-the-badge)](#-compatibility) [![Languages](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-7-9C27B0?style=for-the-badge)](#-speaks-your-language) [**⬇️ Download**](https://github.com/xeloria/ResonanceFX/releases/latest)  •  [**📥 Install**](#-install-in-3-steps)  •  [**✨ Features**](#-whats-inside)  •  [**🩺 Troubleshooting**](#-troubleshooting)  •  [**🔧 Build**](#-build-from-source)  •  [**🐞 Report a bug**](https://github.com/xeloria/ResonanceFX/issues/new/choose)
--- > **🆕 What's new in 2.5.0** — Android 16+ **AIDL effect-HAL support** (One UI 8.5 and newer), and a > **wider, mono-safe differential surround**. Full details in the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md). ## 💡 Why ResonanceFX? | 🎚️ **28 effects, one engine** | 🎧 **Headphones *and* speakers** | | --- | --- | | Equalizers, dynamics, spatial audio, reverb, saturation and speaker tools — all processing on the system mixer, so **every app** benefits: music, video, games, podcasts. | 710-position MIT KEMAR HRTF spatial audio, headphone correction, AutoEQ, **measure your own speaker**, crosstalk-cancelling speaker widening. | | **📊 Measured, not claimed** | **🔒 Free, open and private** | | Every effect's measured frequency response, distortion, stereo width and loudness change ships with the app and with each release — 41 measurements in all. | GPL-3.0-or-later, no ads, no trackers, **no network permission**. The microphone is used only while you measure a speaker, and the audio never leaves memory. |
| 🎚️ **Effects** | 📚 **Presets** | 🩺 **Status** | ⚙️ **Settings** | | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | Every effect, grouped and explained | Saved setups, per-device profiles, JSON import/export | Live engine state and one-tap diagnostics | Language, theme, measurement, defaults |
## ✨ What's inside **🎵 Tone & loudness** 10-band equalizer with 56 presets · 15/31-band graphic EQ · parametric EQ with up to 32 bands · AutoEQ for thousands of headphones · ISO 226 loudness compensation that follows the volume · bass and clarity enhancers · spectrum extension · playback gain control. **🥁 Dynamics** Multiband compressor · dynamic EQ · de-esser · FET compressor · auditory protection. **🌌 Space & immersion** Spatial audio with 710-position MIT KEMAR HRTF and **3DoF head tracking** on Android 13+ · convolver for impulse responses (auto-resampled to the live output rate) · field surround · **differential surround** (mid/side Haas, now wider and mono-safe) · headphone surround+ · reverberation · crossfeed. **🎨 Character** Tube simulator · AnalogX · dynamic system with 103 headphone profiles · headphone correction from `.vdc` profiles. **🔊 Speakers** Speaker correction for phone, tablet, laptop, Bluetooth, car and TV profiles · **measure your own speaker** with the phone's microphone · speaker protection that stops a small driver from excursing too far or distorting · speaker widening with crosstalk cancellation that follows how the device is held. **🛠️ Built to live on a phone** Per-device profiles that switch automatically for speaker, wired, every Bluetooth device and USB DAC · JSON presets with import and export · built-in test tone · live status and a copyable diagnostics report · seven languages · any channel layout from 1 to 28 · PCM 16/24/32-bit, 8.24 and float · saturating output (no wrap-around crackle) · real-time-safe locking · bounds-checked commands · arm, arm64, x86 and x86_64 · 16 KB page support · automatic re-attach after audioserver restarts and impulse-response re-upload when the output sample rate changes. ## 📥 Install in 3 steps
**1. Get both files** → [latest release](https://github.com/xeloria/ResonanceFX/releases/latest)   **2. Flash the module** → reboot   **3. Install the app** → turn effects on
1. **Flash** `ResonanceFX-.zip` in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch (or in TWRP / OrangeFox), then reboot. 2. **Install** `ResonanceFX.apk` and open it. 3. Turn effects on in the **Effects** tab. **Status** then walks through the chain: **engine registered → attached → stream accepted → processing**. > 💡 **Updating?** Flash the new zip over the old one, reboot, then update the APK. Profiles and > presets are kept. If the APK refuses to install, it was signed with a different key — uninstall > the old app and install the new one. ## 🩺 Troubleshooting | Symptom | Fix | | --- | --- | | **Status says the engine isn't registered** | Tap the module's **Action** button in your root manager. It re-patches every config, re-applies mounts, restarts the audio services and prints what it found. Reboot, then check again. | | **`UUID not found in HAL and proxy list`** on Android 16 | The ROM only loads AIDL effect plug-ins. Use **2.5.0 or newer**; the module installs `libresonancefx_aidl_.so` automatically. | | **Effects are on but nothing sounds different** | Make sure audio is playing and the effect switch is on. Try the built-in **test tone** in Status, and check the per-device profile for the output you're using. | | **Sound stops after a call or a Bluetooth switch** | The engine re-attaches on its own; if it doesn't, tap **Action**, then reboot. | | **Need help or want to report a bug** | In the app: **Status → Copy report**. Attach that plus the logs below to an issue. | **Logs:** `/data/adb/resonancefx/logs/` — `install.log`, `boot.log`, `logcat.txt`, `action.log`. After every boot the module description shows a ✅ / ⚠️ / ❌ verdict, checked against the audio HAL's own list of registered effects. ## 📋 Compatibility | Requirement | Details | | --- | --- | | **Android** | 5.0+ (API 21+) for the module · 6.0+ (API 23+) for the app | | **Root** | Magisk 20.4+, KernelSU or APatch | | **CPU** | arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, x86 — the 32-bit engine is installed too when the device has 32-bit userspace | | **Audio HAL** | Legacy/HIDL effect libraries, and AIDL effect plug-ins on Android 16+ | | **Android 16+ note** | The AIDL engine is currently built for **arm64-v8a**; other ABIs fall back to the legacy engine | ## 🔬 How the module loads reliably
For the curious — how ResonanceFX survives every ROM, OTA and audio restart - Finds every `audio_effects*.xml` / `.conf` (HIDL, AIDL `audio_effects_config.xml`, SKU variants, vendor-specific names) on `/odm`, `/vendor`, `/system_ext`, `/product`, `/my_product` and `/mi_ext` (plus `/system` on Android 7 and older), and adds the effect to all of them — which files a HAL loads is vendor-specific. - Detects whether the ROM's effect factory uses the legacy `audio_effect_library_t` ABI (HIDL HALs, and AIDL HALs that kept native effect libraries) or the AIDL plug-in ABI, then targets the matching engine build and config entry shape. The AIDL config parser needs `type="…"` for effects that are not one of Android's built-in types. - Re-generates the patched copies from the **current stock files on every boot**, so OTA updates never leave stale configs. - Patching is idempotent and tolerant: it removes stale entries, handles inline and self-closing ``, ignores commented-out tags, and reuses the `soundfx` path in legacy `.conf` files. - Uses the root manager's own overlay first, verifies after mounting, then bind-mounts only what is missing — with SELinux labels copied from the originals. - Installs the 32-bit engine too when the device has 32-bit userspace (many 64-bit phones still run a 32-bit audio HAL).
## 🔒 Privacy No ads. No analytics. No telemetry. The app has **no network permission** at all. The microphone is opened only while you measure a speaker, and the recording is processed in memory and then discarded — it is never written to storage or sent anywhere. ## 🌍 Speaks your language English, 日本語, Русский, 简体中文, Español, 한국어 and Français. The app follows the device language automatically, and **Settings → Language** overrides it (including *Follow system*). Everything is translated: effects and their descriptions, controls, status, speaker measurement, presets, errors, and the measurement page. Want to add a language? See [`docs/TRANSLATING.md`](docs/TRANSLATING.md) — `scripts/check-translations.py` keeps every translation in sync with the English source. ## 🔧 Build from source **Requirements:** Android SDK with NDK 27+, CMake 3.22+, JDK 21; Linux or WSL with `g++` for the engine tests. ```sh scripts/build-engine.sh # out/engine//libresonancefx.so scripts/build-module.sh # out/ResonanceFX-.zip (cd app && ./gradlew assembleRelease) # app/app/build/outputs/apk/release/ tests/test-patch.sh # config patcher (prefix with "busybox sh" to test busybox) tests/test-factory.sh # legacy vs AIDL factory selection tests/test-action.sh # the module's Action button tests/run-engine-tests.sh # engine through AELI with ASan/UBSan (Linux/WSL) tests/measure-engine.sh # per-effect measurements (Linux/WSL) tests/emulator-test.sh # end to end on a rooted emulator/device over adb python scripts/check-translations.py # translation completeness (cd app && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug) ``` The AIDL front-end needs the platform's frozen interface library for the target ABI at link time. The arm64 copy used for the Galaxy A57 lives in [`engine/src/android/aidl/prebuilt/`](engine/src/android/aidl/prebuilt/README.md), and the contract is documented in [`engine/src/android/aidl/README.md`](engine/src/android/aidl/README.md). It is a build input only — at runtime the effect HAL supplies its own copy from `/system/lib64`. Release APKs are signed with the key given in `RFX_KEYSTORE`, `RFX_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `RFX_KEY_ALIAS` and `RFX_KEY_PASSWORD`; without them the debug key is used. Pushing a `v*` tag builds the module and app on GitHub Actions and publishes a release — see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#releases). ## 📁 Project layout | Path | Contents | | --- | --- | | `engine/` | DSP engine — `src/android/` effect glue (legacy AELI + AIDL), `src/core/` DSP core, `src/fx/` effects | | `module/` | Root module scripts (`common.sh` holds the logic) | | `app/` | Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material You) | | `docs/` | Licensing and translation notes | | `tests/` | Patcher fixtures and test runners | | `.github/` | CI, release workflow, issue templates | ## 🤝 Contributing Bug reports, device reports and pull requests are all welcome. Read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) for what to attach to a report and what CI checks. Sound changes should come with before/after `tests/measure-engine.sh` output. ## 🙏 Credits - **DSP core:** Basilar, also by Xeloria (GPL-3.0-or-later). - **Differential surround refactor:** [@xiamoYuF](https://github.com/xiamoYuF) (PR #7). - **HRTF data:** MIT KEMAR measurements — W. G. Gardner and K. D. Martin, *HRTF Measurements of a KEMAR Dummy-Head Microphone*, MIT Media Lab, 1994. - **Headphone profiles:** [AutoEq](https://github.com/jaakkopasanen/AutoEq) by Jaakko Pasanen (MIT), measurements by their respective sources. - **AIDL front-end:** AOSP `EffectImpl` / `EffectContext` / `EffectThread` and FMQ sources (Apache-2.0), vendored under `engine/src/android/aidl/third_party/`. - **Installer conventions:** the Magisk module template by Zackptg5 and contributors. ## 📄 License GPL-3.0-or-later — see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE), [`NOTICE`](NOTICE) for third-party data attributions, and [`docs/LICENSING.md`](docs/LICENSING.md) for how the engine was written.
**Made with 🎧 by [Xeloria](https://github.com/xeloria)** If ResonanceFX makes your music better, consider giving the repo a ⭐ — it helps other people find it.

System-wide audio, exactly how you want to hear it.

A free, open-source, privacy-respecting audio effects suite for rooted Android — a hardened

real-time DSP engine, a universal Magisk / KernelSU / APatch module, and a modern Material You app.

> 🆕 What's new in 2.5.0 — Android 16+ AIDL effect-HAL support (One UI 8.5 and newer), and a

> wider, mono-safe differential surround. Full details in the changelog.

💡 Why ResonanceFX?

| 🎚️ 28 effects, one engine | 🎧 **Headphones *and* speakers** |

| --- | --- |

| Equalizers, dynamics, spatial audio, reverb, saturation and speaker tools — all processing on the system mixer, so every app benefits: music, video, games, podcasts. | 710-position MIT KEMAR HRTF spatial audio, headphone correction, AutoEQ, measure your own speaker, crosstalk-cancelling speaker widening. |

| 📊 Measured, not claimed | 🔒 Free, open and private |

| Every effect's measured frequency response, distortion, stereo width and loudness change ships with the app and with each release — 41 measurements in all. | GPL-3.0-or-later, no ads, no trackers, no network permission. The microphone is used only while you measure a speaker, and the audio never leaves memory. |

| 🎚️ Effects | 📚 Presets | 🩺 Status | ⚙️ Settings |

| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |

| Every effect, grouped and explained | Saved setups, per-device profiles, JSON import/export | Live engine state and one-tap diagnostics | Language, theme, measurement, defaults |

✨ What's inside

🎵 Tone & loudness

10-band equalizer with 56 presets · 15/31-band graphic EQ · parametric EQ with up to 32 bands ·

AutoEQ for thousands of headphones · ISO 226 loudness compensation that follows the volume ·

bass and clarity enhancers · spectrum extension · playback gain control.

🥁 Dynamics

Multiband compressor · dynamic EQ · de-esser · FET compressor · auditory protection.

🌌 Space & immersion

Spatial audio with 710-position MIT KEMAR HRTF and 3DoF head tracking on Android 13+ ·

convolver for impulse responses (auto-resampled to the live output rate) · field surround ·

differential surround (mid/side Haas, now wider and mono-safe) · headphone surround+ ·

reverberation · crossfeed.

🎨 Character

Tube simulator · AnalogX · dynamic system with 103 headphone profiles · headphone correction

from .vdc profiles.

🔊 Speakers

Speaker correction for phone, tablet, laptop, Bluetooth, car and TV profiles · **measure your

own speaker** with the phone's microphone · speaker protection that stops a small driver from

excursing too far or distorting · speaker widening with crosstalk cancellation that follows how

the device is held.

🛠️ Built to live on a phone

Per-device profiles that switch automatically for speaker, wired, every Bluetooth device and USB

DAC · JSON presets with import and export · built-in test tone · live status and a copyable

diagnostics report · seven languages · any channel layout from 1 to 28 · PCM 16/24/32-bit, 8.24

and float · saturating output (no wrap-around crackle) · real-time-safe locking · bounds-checked

commands · arm, arm64, x86 and x86_64 · 16 KB page support · automatic re-attach after audioserver

restarts and impulse-response re-upload when the output sample rate changes.

📥 Install in 3 steps

1. Get both files → latest release

  2. Flash the module → reboot   3. Install the app → turn effects on

  • **Flash** `ResonanceFX-.zip` in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch (or in TWRP / OrangeFox),

    • then reboot.

  • **Install** `ResonanceFX.apk` and open it.
  • Turn effects on in the **Effects** tab. **Status** then walks through the chain:

    • engine registered → attached → stream accepted → processing.

    > 💡 Updating? Flash the new zip over the old one, reboot, then update the APK. Profiles and

    > presets are kept. If the APK refuses to install, it was signed with a different key — uninstall

    > the old app and install the new one.

    🩺 Troubleshooting

    | Symptom | Fix |

    | --- | --- |

    | Status says the engine isn't registered | Tap the module's Action button in your root manager. It re-patches every config, re-applies mounts, restarts the audio services and prints what it found. Reboot, then check again. |

    | UUID not found in HAL and proxy list on Android 16 | The ROM only loads AIDL effect plug-ins. Use 2.5.0 or newer; the module installs libresonancefx_aidl_.so automatically. |

    | Effects are on but nothing sounds different | Make sure audio is playing and the effect switch is on. Try the built-in test tone in Status, and check the per-device profile for the output you're using. |

    | Sound stops after a call or a Bluetooth switch | The engine re-attaches on its own; if it doesn't, tap Action, then reboot. |

    | Need help or want to report a bug | In the app: Status → Copy report. Attach that plus the logs below to an issue. |

    Logs: /data/adb/resonancefx/logs/ — install.log, boot.log, logcat.txt, action.log.

    After every boot the module description shows a ✅ / ⚠️ / ❌ verdict, checked against the audio

    HAL's own list of registered effects.

    📋 Compatibility

    | Requirement | Details |

    | --- | --- |

    | Android | 5.0+ (API 21+) for the module · 6.0+ (API 23+) for the app |

    | Root | Magisk 20.4+, KernelSU or APatch |

    | CPU | arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, x86 — the 32-bit engine is installed too when the device has 32-bit userspace |

    | Audio HAL | Legacy/HIDL effect libraries, and AIDL effect plug-ins on Android 16+ |

    | Android 16+ note | The AIDL engine is currently built for arm64-v8a; other ABIs fall back to the legacy engine |

    🔬 How the module loads reliably

    For the curious — how ResonanceFX survives every ROM, OTA and audio restart

  • Finds every `audio_effects*.xml` / `.conf` (HIDL, AIDL `audio_effects_config.xml`, SKU

    • variants, vendor-specific names) on /odm, /vendor, /system_ext, /product,

    /my_product and /mi_ext (plus /system on Android 7 and older), and adds the effect to

    all of them — which files a HAL loads is vendor-specific.

  • Detects whether the ROM's effect factory uses the legacy `audio_effect_library_t` ABI (HIDL

    • HALs, and AIDL HALs that kept native effect libraries) or the AIDL plug-in ABI, then targets

    the matching engine build and config entry shape. The AIDL config parser needs type="…"

    for effects that are not one of Android's built-in types.

  • Re-generates the patched copies from the **current stock files on every boot**, so OTA

    • updates never leave stale configs.

  • Patching is idempotent and tolerant: it removes stale entries, handles inline and

    • self-closing , ignores commented-out tags, and reuses the soundfx path in

    legacy .conf files.

  • Uses the root manager's own overlay first, verifies after mounting, then bind-mounts only

    • what is missing — with SELinux labels copied from the originals.

  • Installs the 32-bit engine too when the device has 32-bit userspace (many 64-bit phones still

    • run a 32-bit audio HAL).

    🔒 Privacy

    No ads. No analytics. No telemetry. The app has no network permission at all. The microphone

    is opened only while you measure a speaker, and the recording is processed in memory and then

    discarded — it is never written to storage or sent anywhere.

    🌍 Speaks your language

    English, 日本語, Русский, 简体中文, Español, 한국어 and Français. The app follows the device

    language automatically, and Settings → Language overrides it (including *Follow system*).

    Everything is translated: effects and their descriptions, controls, status, speaker measurement,

    presets, errors, and the measurement page.

    Want to add a language? See docs/TRANSLATING.md — scripts/check-translations.py

    keeps every translation in sync with the English source.

    🔧 Build from source

    Requirements: Android SDK with NDK 27+, CMake 3.22+, JDK 21; Linux or WSL with g++ for the

    engine tests.

    scripts/build-engine.sh                  # out/engine/<abi>/libresonancefx.so
scripts/build-module.sh                  # out/ResonanceFX-<version>.zip
(cd app && ./gradlew assembleRelease)    # app/app/build/outputs/apk/release/

tests/test-patch.sh                      # config patcher (prefix with "busybox sh" to test busybox)
tests/test-factory.sh                    # legacy vs AIDL factory selection
tests/test-action.sh                     # the module's Action button
tests/run-engine-tests.sh                # engine through AELI with ASan/UBSan (Linux/WSL)
tests/measure-engine.sh                  # per-effect measurements (Linux/WSL)
tests/emulator-test.sh                   # end to end on a rooted emulator/device over adb
python scripts/check-translations.py     # translation completeness
(cd app && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug)

    The AIDL front-end needs the platform's frozen interface library for the target ABI at link time.

    The arm64 copy used for the Galaxy A57 lives in

    engine/src/android/aidl/prebuilt/, and the

    contract is documented in engine/src/android/aidl/README.md.

    It is a build input only — at runtime the effect HAL supplies its own copy from /system/lib64.

    Release APKs are signed with the key given in RFX_KEYSTORE, RFX_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD,

    RFX_KEY_ALIAS and RFX_KEY_PASSWORD; without them the debug key is used. Pushing a v* tag

    builds the module and app on GitHub Actions and publishes a release — see

    CONTRIBUTING.md.

    📁 Project layout

    | Path | Contents |

    | --- | --- |

    | engine/ | DSP engine — src/android/ effect glue (legacy AELI + AIDL), src/core/ DSP core, src/fx/ effects |

    | module/ | Root module scripts (common.sh holds the logic) |

    | app/ | Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material You) |

    | docs/ | Licensing and translation notes |

    | tests/ | Patcher fixtures and test runners |

    | .github/ | CI, release workflow, issue templates |

    🤝 Contributing

    Bug reports, device reports and pull requests are all welcome. Read

    CONTRIBUTING.md for what to attach to a report and what CI checks. Sound

    changes should come with before/after tests/measure-engine.sh output.

    🙏 Credits

  • **DSP core:** Basilar, also by Xeloria (GPL-3.0-or-later).
  • **Differential surround refactor:** [@xiamoYuF](https://github.com/xiamoYuF) (PR #7).
  • **HRTF data:** MIT KEMAR measurements — W. G. Gardner and K. D. Martin, *HRTF Measurements of

    • a KEMAR Dummy-Head Microphone*, MIT Media Lab, 1994.

  • **Headphone profiles:** [AutoEq](https://github.com/jaakkopasanen/AutoEq) by Jaakko Pasanen

    • (MIT), measurements by their respective sources.

  • **AIDL front-end:** AOSP `EffectImpl` / `EffectContext` / `EffectThread` and FMQ sources

    • (Apache-2.0), vendored under engine/src/android/aidl/third_party/.

  • **Installer conventions:** the Magisk module template by Zackptg5 and contributors.

    • 📄 License

    GPL-3.0-or-later — see LICENSE, NOTICE for third-party data

    attributions, and docs/LICENSING.md for how the engine was written.

    Made with 🎧 by Xeloria

    If ResonanceFX makes your music better, consider giving the repo a ⭐ — it helps other people find it.
